about.title: About Ruda
about.description: Ruda is a 2D simulator inspired by Minecraft's redstone. It is not a copy: signals, rules and blocks deviate from the original.
about.disclaimer: An independent project, not made by or affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.
about.madeWithClaude: The game was programmed with the help of Claude, an AI assistant by Anthropic.

v1_1: Labels: press T to write a short note anywhere in the world.
Left click now places and uses blocks, right click breaks them, like in most games. Space and Delete do the same at the cursor.
v1_0: Endless 2D world with wires, crossings, levers, buttons, torches, delayers, lamps, power blocks and stone.
Pistons that push chains of blocks, with animation.
Worlds are saved in the browser and can be imported and exported as .ruda files.
Blocky game-like interface, light and dark look, and a start screen with a live preview.
